package app

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	rtesting "alder/rt/testing"
)

// TestAlderTests runs the app's generated test table (TestGen_Tests) through rtesting.Run as
// `alder test` does: the pure tests' recorded sides, Test.run's rollback of a failed task and
// its trace, Test.trace, and the Tests table's order and kinds.
func TestAlderTests(t *testing.T) {
	if TestSession() == nil {
		t.Fatal("TestSession is nil for an app with an App module")
	}
	var keys []string
	for _, c := range Tests {
		kind := "pure"
		if c.Task != nil {
			kind = "task"
		}
		keys = append(keys, c.Module+" "+c.Name+" "+kind)
	}
	wantKeys := []string{
		"Shop total adds pure",
		"Shop total is wrong pure",
		"Shop.Orders a failed run undoes its writes task",
		"Shop.Orders a successful run keeps its insert task",
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(keys, wantKeys) {
		t.Fatalf("Tests: %q, want %q", keys, wantKeys)
	}
	rs := rtesting.Run(Tests, rtesting.Options{Tables: Tables, Session: TestSession(), Caps: Caps{}.Registry()})
	if len(rs) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("%d results", len(rs))
	}
	if r := rs[0]; !r.OK || r.Left != "3" || r.Right != "3" || r.Trace != nil {
		t.Errorf("total adds: %+v", r)
	}
	if r := rs[1]; r.OK || r.Left != "3" || r.Right != "4" || r.Error != "" {
		t.Errorf("total is wrong: %+v", r)
	}
	r := rs[2]
	if !r.OK || r.Error != "" {
		t.Errorf("a failed run: %+v", r)
	}
	wantTrace := []string{"Db.insert Item", "Test.run", "Db.insert Item", "Test.trace", "Db.count Item"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Trace, wantTrace) {
		t.Errorf("a failed run's trace: %q, want %q", r.Trace, wantTrace)
	}
	if r.Left == "" || r.Left != r.Right {
		t.Errorf("a failed run's sides: %q vs %q", r.Left, r.Right)
	}
	if r := rs[3]; !r.OK || r.Left != "1" || r.Right != "1" {
		t.Errorf("a successful run: %+v", r)
	}
}
